name: How do I choose the right contractor for my remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for your remodel, look for experience, strong communication skills, and a clear understanding of your vision. Check references, review their portfolio, and ensure they are licensed and insured. It's also important to feel comfortable with their team and their proposed process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on experience, communication, references, portfolio, and proper licensing and insurance.
